newsitem.title: USA: Terra, Farmland say in ag chem venture.
newsitem.headline: Terra, Farmland say in ag chem venture.

text.p: Terra Industries Inc and Farmland Industries agreed to a 50-50 joint venture to be called Omnium LLC that will formulate crop protection products, the two companies said.
A Terra plant in Blytheville, Ark., and a Farmland plant in St. Joseph, Mo., will be placed in the venture, they said.
Products will include herbicides, fungicides and other crop protection products, they said.
"Combining these two production facilities into one organization will result in a much stronger business," said Stan Reimann, crop production vice president at Farmland.

Omnium will support marketing and distribution of each company's agricultural chemicals business, including Terra's Riverside brand of crop protection products and WILFARM, Farmland's joint venture with Wilbur-Ellis. Omnium will be based in St. Joseph, the companies said.
Farmland is the largest farmer-owned cooperative in North America. Terra is a major agricultural products firm.
